title: At The Museum
body: Yesterday we ___ to the new museum and stayed there for almost two hours.

question.explain_tr: 'Yesterday' geçmiş zaman ister; go fiilinin ikinci hali **went**'tir.

title: Next Door
body: She has been our neighbour ___ 2019 and we still meet her every morning.

question.explain_tr: Başlangıç noktası verildiğinde **since** kullanılır: since 2019. 'for' ise süre uzunluğu içindir.

title: Two Exams
body: This exam was ___ difficult than the one we took last month.

question.explain_tr: Uzun sıfatlarda karşılaştırma **more + sıfat + than** ile yapılır.

title: Weekend Plans
body: I am going to ___ my grandparents next weekend if the weather is good.

question.explain_tr: 'going to' kalıbından sonra fiilin yalın hali gelir: going to **visit**.

title: Power Cut
body: We ___ watching a film when the lights suddenly went out last night.

question.explain_tr: Çoğul özne (we) ile geçmiş sürekli zaman **were + -ing** olur.

title: If It Rains
body: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ at home and watch something together.

question.explain_tr: Birinci tip koşul cümlesinde: If + geniş zaman, **will + fiil**.

title: Take It With You
body: You ___ take an umbrella today because it is going to rain this afternoon.

question.explain_tr: Tavsiye vermek için **should** kullanılır.

title: Half Empty
body: There were ___ people at the concert than we had expected on a Friday.

question.explain_tr: Sayılabilen isimlerle **fewer** kullanılır; 'less' sayılamayanlar içindir.

title: In This Flat
body: I have lived in this flat ___ five years and I still like it.

question.explain_tr: Süre uzunluğu verildiğinde **for** kullanılır: for five years.

title: Who Speaks More
body: She speaks English ___ than her brother, but he writes more carefully.

question.explain_tr: good sıfatının karşılaştırma hali düzensizdir: **better**.

title: A Boring Film
body: The film was so boring that I ___ asleep before the middle of it.

question.explain_tr: 'uykuya dalmak' kalıbı **fall asleep**; geçmiş hali fell'dir. 'felt' ise feel fiilinden gelir.

title: Too Early
body: They arrived ___ the airport almost two hours before the flight.

question.explain_tr: arrive fiili havaalanı gibi noktalarla **at** ile kullanılır: arrive at the airport.

title: Locked Out
body: I ___ my keys yesterday, so I could not open the door for an hour.

question.explain_tr: 'yesterday' geçmiş zaman ister; lose fiilinin ikinci hali **lost**'tur.

title: Too Loud
body: Could you turn ___ the music a little? The neighbours are already asleep.

question.explain_tr: Sesi kısmak **turn down**, açmak ise turn up'tır.

title: Early Mornings
body: He is used ___ getting up at five because of his job at the bakery.

question.explain_tr: 'alışkın olmak' kalıbı **be used to + fiil-ing** biçimindedir.

title: Closing Time
body: We must ___ before the library closes at six o'clock this evening.

question.explain_tr: must gibi modal fiillerden sonra yalın fiil gelir: must **leave**.

title: Around The Corner
body: This is the ___ restaurant in the neighbourhood and it is always full.

question.explain_tr: Bir grubun içinde en üstün için **the best** kullanılır.

title: Stayed In
body: I did not go out yesterday ___ the weather was really terrible all day.

question.explain_tr: Sebep bildirmek için **because** kullanılır.

title: Finished Anyway
body: She was extremely tired, ___ she still finished the report before midnight.

question.explain_tr: Beklenmedik bir sonuç geldiği için karşıtlık bağlacı **but** gerekir.

title: At The Stop
body: How long ___ you wait for the bus at the stop yesterday morning?

question.explain_tr: Geçmiş zaman sorusunda yardımcı fiil **did** olur ve ana fiil yalın kalır.

title: Almost Gone
body: There is ___ sugar left in the jar, so we need to buy some more.

question.explain_tr: Sayılamayan isimle 'çok az' anlamı **little** ile verilir; few sayılabilenler içindir.

title: Hurry Up
body: The train leaves ___ ten minutes, so we should walk to the platform now.

question.explain_tr: '... sonra' anlamında gelecek bir zaman için **in** kullanılır: in ten minutes.

title: Closed Sunday
body: Neither of the two shops ___ open on Sunday, so we went on Monday.

question.explain_tr: 'Neither of' tekil kabul edilir, bu yüzden **is** gelir.

title: A Quiet Night
body: I would rather ___ at home tonight than go to a crowded place.

question.explain_tr: 'would rather' kalıbından sonra yalın fiil gelir: would rather **stay**.

title: Not Yet
body: I have ___ finished the first part, but the second one is still open.

question.explain_tr: Olumlu cümlede 'çoktan' anlamı **already** ile verilir; 'yet' olumsuz ve sorularda kullanılır.
